title: [CI] Downgrading CUDA driver results: No devices were found
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

When Trying to downgrade from CUDA 13.0 compatible driver ``580.82.07`` to CUDA 12.0 minimum driver ``525.105.17`` after driver install we get. Querying nvidia-smi like this:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv,noheader --id=0
```

We get:
```
+ INSTALLED_DRIVER_VERSION='No devices were found'
+ NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS=6
```

github-action code:
https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/blob/main/.github/actions/setup-nvidia/action.yml

HUD Failures: https://hud.pytorch.org/hud/pytorch/pytorch/main/1?per_page=50&name_filter=periodic%20%2F%20linux-jammy-cuda12.4-py3.10-gcc11

This breaks following jobs:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/163657



### Versions

2.10.0 and 2.9.0
